description_en: Returns media assets that match the specified conditions
description_zh: 根据用户所提供参数，返回符合条件的媒资信息
kebab_example: aliyun ice search-media --match Title_=_China_and_utcCreate_=_1693367158561_,_1693367158562 --sort-by utcCreate:Desc --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --entity-id 2d3bf1e35a1e42b5ab338d701efa0000 --scroll-token F8C4F642184DBDA5D93907A70AAE0000 --search-lib-name test-1 --custom-filters '{"intField1":{"gte":12,"lte":13},"strField2":["cd","de"],"strField1":"abc"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchMedia

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for the search. <props="china">For syntax rules, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584256.html.</props>
parameters.name: match

parameters.help_en: The sort field and sort order. Separate multiple sort criteria with a comma (,)
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段和排序顺序。多个使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. The default value is 1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of results per page. The default value is 10, and the maximum value is 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的数据条数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The scroll token for deep pagination. It is a 32-character string. This parameter is not required for the first search request. If a search is successful, the response includes a `ScrollToken` to mark the current position. Use this token in subsequent requests to retrieve the next page of results. This parameter is required to iterate through all matching results. For optimal performance, use this parameter when the `PageNo` value exceeds 200. You can scroll only forward, up to a maximum of 1,000 media assets
parameters.help_zh: 翻页标识。32字段。第一次执行搜索请求时不用设置本参数。搜索请求命中数据时，服务端会返回该参数值，用于记录当前搜索数据的位置地址。请记录返回的参数值，下一次搜索时按下述要求或建议设置本参数：需要遍历搜索条件命中的所有数据时，本参数必须设置。当PageNo参数取值超过200时，建议设置本参数优化搜索性能。只能向后翻页，最大翻页距离为1000媒资
parameters.name: scroll_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the search library
parameters.name: search_lib_name

parameters.help_en:
The custom filter, specified as a JSON string. Supports the integer field intField1 and the string fields strField1 and strField2. Use only one match type per field. Conditions on different fields are combined with a logical AND.

Exact match: `{"intField1":12,"strField1":"abc"}`

Multi-value match: `{"intField1":[12,13],"strField1":["abc","cd"]}`

Range match: `{"intField1":{"gte":12,"lte":13}}`
parameters.name: custom_filters
